messages:
deploy-bot: PROD deploy started: service="inference-runtime" environment=production tag=v3.5.0 commit=e3f1c9a. Initiated by @Maya R. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% (staged). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rollback window: first 15m. @ops_oncall FYI.

Maya R: Kicking off smoke checks and quick validation suite now. Will update on any failures.

Samir K: Observability team on standby — tracking p95/latency, error rate, and kv-cache miss.

Jessica L: Pinning non-breaking config changes, backing up runtime config. No migrations in this release.

deploy-bot: Canary step: shifting 5% -> 20% traffic. Expected ramp ~8m. Current status: shifting...

observability-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: p50=44ms p95=180ms error_rate=0.12% kv_cache_miss=4.1% (baseline kv_cache_miss=3.8%).

Maya R: Smoke: sample end-to-end trace passed, inference responses look correct. Proceeding with caution to 50% after metrics confirm.

Samir K: Noted a small latency spike in eu-west-1 around the k8s node pool — holding on advancing for 2m while I check the hotpath.

Maya R: Hold acknowledged. @deploy-bot please pause rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 20% per request from @Samir K. Not advancing until a manual resume.

Samir K: Root cause identified: kernel param for NUMA affinity not applied on ~6 nodes (env var missing). Will patch pool with correct env var, pod rolling restart. ETA ~5m.

Jessica L: Patch ready and tested in staging. Applying to affected node set now; will coordinate restarts.

deploy-bot: Applying patch and restarting impacted pods (subset). Running health checks after restart.

observability-bot: Post-patch metrics: p95 reduced to 170ms, error_rate stable at 0.11%, kv_cache_miss down to 3.9%.

Maya R: Validation OK. No errors in trace samples. Resume rollout when ready.

Samir K: I'm happy to resume. No further anomalous traces.

deploy-bot: Resuming rollout: advancing 20% -> 50% -> 100% over next 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: PROD deploy COMPLETE: service=inference-runtime tag=v3.5.0 commit=e3f1c9a. Start=2245013377 Finish=2245013598. Notes: applied env var patch for kernel NUMA affinity on subset of nodes; rollback not required.

Trent B: Adding to release notes: "inference-runtime: performance improvements + KV-cache stability fixes; addressed NUMA affinity env var on subset of nodes."

Maya R: Thanks all — marking this deployment as completed. :tada:

ops_oncall: Oncall confirms no new alerts in the 30m following completion. Standing down.
